articles.title: Viral Fall at Birthday Bash: Brij Bhushan Trips on Stage, Video Sparks Meme Storm
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: Former BJP MP and ex-Wrestling Federation of India president Brij Bhushan Sharan Singh suffered a minor mishap during his 69th birthday celebrations on January 8, 2026, when he lost balance on stage and fell face-first.

body.html:
Former BJP MP and ex-Wrestling Federation of India president Brij Bhushan Sharan Singh suffered a minor mishap during his 69th birthday celebrations on January 8, 2026, when he lost balance on stage and fell face-first.

The incident occurred at the Rashtra Katha Mahotsav, organised in support of his son Karan Bhushan Singh. A video shows Singh stumbling while crossing a barrier amid a crowded gathering. He quickly got up, smiled, and was assisted by supporters and security personnel. No injuries were reported, and the programme continued.

The 30-second clip went viral on platforms such as X and Instagram, triggering memes and sarcastic reactions. Several Hindi news outlets described the moment as Singh “falling face down and somersaulting”.

The eight-day event, featuring religious leader Riteshwar Maharaj, also drew attention for its lavish celebrations, including gifts such as a Rs 2.5 crore racehorse, a gold chain and a cow. Singh was also seen feeding cake to Muslim children during the event.

articles.title: TlLate for Exam, Humiliated Over Periods: Hyderabad Student’s Shocking Death Sparks Outrage
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: Hyderabad: A 16-year-old intermediate student, Varshini, studying first-year MPC at Dr Munaga Rama Mohan Rao Government Girls Junior College, Maredpally, died after allegedly being humiliated by lecturers for arriving late to an examination.

body.html:
Hyderabad: A 16-year-old intermediate student, Varshini, studying first-year MPC at Dr Munaga Rama Mohan Rao Government Girls Junior College, Maredpally, died after allegedly being humiliated by lecturers for arriving late to an examination.

According to the family, Varshini reached the exam hall late and explained that the delay was due to her menstrual period. However, two lecturers—Madhura and Srilakshmi—allegedly refused her entry, accused her of “acting,” and demanded proof in front of other students. Distressed by the incident, Varshini returned to her home in Maruti Nagar, Malkajgiri, where she collapsed and lost consciousness.

She was rushed to Gandhi Hospital, where doctors confirmed she had suffered a brain clot due to severe mental stress and hypertension. She died while undergoing treatment on Thursday night.

Following the incident, family members and student organisations staged a protest at the college. Police registered a case against the two lecturers under Section 194 of the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita (BNS) for harassment and abetment. A departmental inquiry committee has also been constituted.

Political leaders, including BRS leaders and former Beverages Corporation chairman Gajjela Nagesh, visited the family and extended financial assistance. Demands have been raised for compensation and a government job for a family member.

articles.title: Betting Addiction Exposed: Amberpet SI Arrested for Pawning Seized Gold, Revolver ‘Missing’
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: Hyderabad: Sub-Inspector Bhanuprakash Reddy of Amberpet Police Station was arrested on Friday for misusing seized property to clear online betting debts.

body.html:
Hyderabad: Sub-Inspector Bhanuprakash Reddy of Amberpet Police Station was arrested on Friday for misusing seized property to clear online betting debts. Police said Reddy, addicted to betting apps since 2018, pledged 4.3 tolas of gold recovered in a theft case and allegedly won over ₹1 crore during this period.

The matter came to light during an internal inquiry initiated in November last year after the gold could not be returned to the complainant despite the case being settled in a Lok Adalat. During questioning, Reddy admitted to pledging the seized gold. He also claimed that his service revolver went missing while travelling on a train, prompting a deeper investigation.

Senior officials conducted a detailed probe and recovered the pledged gold. Reddy, who had earlier sought a transfer citing selection to a Group-2 post in Andhra Pradesh and later requested relief for an AP electricity department job, was taken into custody based on evidence and remanded to Chanchalguda Jail.

articles.title: ₹5 Lakh Dowry Demand Ends in Tragedy: 19-Year-Old Girl Killed by Fiancé in Jabalpur
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A 19-year-old woman, Richa Rajak, was allegedly murdered by her fiancé just days before their scheduled wedding in the Adhartal police station area of Jabalpur. Richa, a resident of Imliya village, worked at a plastic factory in Richhai.

body.html:
A 19-year-old woman, Richa Rajak, was allegedly murdered by her fiancé just days before their scheduled wedding in the Adhartal police station area of Jabalpur.

Richa, a resident of Imliya village, worked at a plastic factory in Richhai. She was engaged to Sahil Rajak two and a half months ago, and their marriage was fixed for February. Family members said the couple met two years ago at a wedding and later decided to marry with the consent of both families.

Police said that on Thursday evening, while Richa was returning home from work, Sahil Rajak intercepted her along with his friend Ajay Thakur. Following an argument, Sahil allegedly attacked Richa with a knife, stabbing her in the neck and chest. Both accused fled the spot on a motorcycle.

Richa was rushed to Victoria District Hospital and later referred to the Medical College, where she died during treatment.

Richa’s family alleged that Sahil had demanded ₹5 lakh as dowry after the engagement and attacked her after she refused to marry him due to the demand. Police said there were also allegations that Sahil suspected Richa’s character and had been threatening and stalking her for several days.

Police have arrested Sahil Rajak and Ajay Thakur and registered a case of murder. Further investigation is underway.

articles.title: Mother Kills Infant Son, Ends Life; Grandmother Attempts try to end life
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A 27-year-old woman allegedly poisoned her 10-month-old son and died by end life following marital disputes at Meerpet, police said. The woman, Sushma, was married to Yashwanth Reddy, a chartered accountant, for four years. Their son, Yashvardhan Reddy, was 10 months old.

body.html:
A 27-year-old woman allegedly poisoned her 10-month-old son and died by end life following marital disputes at Meerpet, police said.

The woman, Sushma, was married to Yashwanth Reddy, a chartered accountant, for four years. Their son, Yashvardhan Reddy, was 10 months old. Family members told police that the couple had been facing disagreements for the past few days.

On the day of the incident, Sushma was at home with her mother Lalitha (44), who had come for shopping related to a family function. Police said Sushma went into another room, poisoned her infant son and later took her own life.

Yashwanth Reddy returned home around 9.30 pm and found the bedroom door locked from inside. After breaking it open, he found his wife and son lying lifeless and alerted the police.

Lalitha, who witnessed the deaths of her daughter and grandson, allegedly attempted end life unable to bear the shock. She was shifted for medical care.

Police reached the spot, registered a case and are investigating the incident.

articles.title: Indore Horror: Speeding Car Crushed, Ex Minister’s Daughter Among 3 Dead After Birthday Party
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A horrific road accident in Indore claimed the lives of three youths and left one woman critically injured early Friday morning. The incident occurred around 5:15 am in the Ralamandal area. A speeding Tata Nexon rammed into a truck from behind, leaving the car completely mangled.

body.html:
A horrific road accident in Indore claimed the lives of three youths and left one woman critically injured early Friday morning. The incident occurred around 5:15 am in the Ralamandal area.

A speeding Tata Nexon rammed into a truck from behind, leaving the car completely mangled. Three occupants died on the spot. The deceased were identified as Prerna Bachchan, daughter of former state Home Minister Bala Bachchan; Prakhar Kasliwal, son of Congress spokesperson Anand Kasliwal; and transport businessman Mansindhu.

Their friend, Anushka Rathi, sustained serious injuries and is undergoing treatment at a private hospital, where her condition remains critical.

Police said the group was returning from Prakhar Kasliwal’s birthday celebration when the accident occurred. The bodies were trapped inside the vehicle and had to be retrieved by cutting open the car. The truck driver fled the spot, and a case has been registered. A search is underway.

articles.title: Women Vandalize Liquor Shop in Birharu Village | Viral Video | UP News
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: Agra: Tension prevailed in Birharu village under the Saiyan police station area after a group of women vandalised a government country liquor shop, alleging that alcohol sales were disturbing the village atmosphere.

body.html:
Agra: Tension prevailed in Birharu village under the Saiyan police station area after a group of women vandalised a government country liquor shop, alleging that alcohol sales were disturbing the village atmosphere.

According to locals, women gathered near the liquor outlet and smashed bottles, destroying a large quantity of liquor. They complained that people consumed alcohol openly outside the shop, creating problems for women living nearby and restricting their movement.

A video of the incident showing women ransacking the shop has gone viral on social media.

On receiving information, the Saiyan police reached the spot and brought the situation under control. Deputy Commissioner of Police (West) Agra also inspected the site. Police officials said law and order is currently normal, evidence is being collected, and further legal action is underway.
